features.name: Form creation
steps: Create a blank form named Customer Feedback with the description Quarterly product feedback survey.
features.expected: Blank form must be created with the specified name and description.

features.name: Basic questions
steps: Add a required short-answer question named Full name and a paragraph question named Additional comments.
features.expected: Both questions must be added with correct types; the short-answer question is required.

features.name: Multiple choice
steps: Add a required multiple-choice question named Overall experience with exactly Excellent, Good, Fair, and Poor as options.
features.expected: Multiple-choice must be required with exactly the four specified options in order.

features.name: Checkboxes
steps: Add a checkbox question named Features used with Dashboard, Reports, Automation, and Integrations as options.
features.expected: Checkbox question must include all four specified options.

features.name: Dropdown
steps: Add a dropdown question named Department with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Support, preserving that order.
features.expected: Dropdown must contain the four options in the specified order.

features.name: Linear scale
steps: Add a linear-scale question named Satisfaction using a 1-to-5 scale, label the low end Very dissatisfied, and label the high end Very satisfied.
features.expected: Linear scale must be 1-to-5 with the specified end labels.

features.name: Date and time
steps: Add a date question named Preferred date and a time question named Preferred time.
features.expected: Date and time questions must both be added with correct types.

features.name: Question transformation
steps: Create a multiple-choice question with four options, convert it to a checkbox question without changing the question title or option texts, and make it required.
features.expected: Question type must convert to checkbox while preserving title and option texts; required state applies.

features.name: Duplicate and edit
steps: Duplicate the Overall experience question, rename the duplicate to Support experience, change one option, and verify that the original question remains unchanged.
features.expected: Duplicate must be independent; editing the duplicate leaves the original unchanged.

features.name: Reorder questions
steps: Create four questions named Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4, then reorder them so that the final sequence is Q3, Q1, Q4, Q2.
features.expected: Final order must be exactly Q3, Q1, Q4, Q2.

features.name: Delete and recover editing state
steps: Create three questions, delete the middle question, use Undo to restore it, and verify that the original three-question order is restored.
features.expected: Undo must restore the deleted question and the original three-question order.

features.name: Response validation
steps: Add a required short-answer question named Contact email, configure response validation so that only email-formatted input is accepted, and set the custom error text to Enter a valid email address.
features.expected: Only email-formatted input is accepted; invalid input shows the custom error text.

features.name: Numeric validation
steps: Add a short-answer question named Age, require a numeric value between 18 and 65, and set a custom validation error message.
features.expected: Numeric validation must accept 18-65 only; custom error message applies.

features.name: Checkbox validation
steps: Add a checkbox question named Select interests with five options and configure it so that respondents must select at least two options.
features.expected: Respondents must select at least two options to submit.

features.name: Sections
steps: Create three sections named Profile, Product Usage, and Final Feedback, then place the appropriate questions into each section.
features.expected: Three sections must be created with appropriate questions placed in each.

features.name: Section reordering
steps: Create sections A, B, and C, then reorder them so the final sequence is C, A, B without recreating any section.
features.expected: Section order must become C, A, B without recreating sections.

features.name: Conditional routing
steps: Create a required multiple-choice question named Do you use the product? with Yes and No. Route Yes to the Product Usage section and route No directly to the Final Feedback section.
features.expected: Yes must route to Product Usage; No must route directly to Final Feedback.

features.name: Conditional end-to-end flow
steps: Build a three-section form where Business respondents are routed to a business-details section and Personal respondents skip it. Preview the form twice and verify that each answer follows the correct path.
features.expected: Business and Personal answers must each follow the correct path in preview.

features.name: Conditional submission
steps: Create a routing question where one answer continues to another section and another answer submits the form immediately. Verify both paths in preview mode.
features.expected: One answer continues to another section; another submits immediately; both paths work in preview.

features.name: Theme customization
steps: Change the form theme color, background color, title font, question font, and body-text font while preserving all form content.
features.expected: Theme changes (color, background, fonts) must apply without altering form content.

features.name: Presentation settings
steps: Configure the form to show a custom confirmation message Thank you for your feedback, display the link to submit another response, and keep question shuffling disabled.
features.expected: Confirmation message and submit-another link must apply; shuffling stays disabled.

features.name: Default question behavior
steps: Configure question defaults so that newly created questions are required by default, add a new question, and verify that it inherits the required setting.
features.expected: New questions must inherit the required-by-default setting.

features.name: Publish
steps: Publish the completed form, allow responder access through the published form, and verify through Preview that the responder-facing version contains all expected questions and sections.
features.expected: Published form must expose all expected questions and sections to responders via Preview.

features.name: Response lifecycle
steps: Publish a form, submit one deterministic response through the responder view, return to the editor, and verify that the response count increases by one and the submitted values appear under Responses.
features.expected: Submitted response must increase the count by one and appear under Responses with correct values.

features.name: Multiple response verification
steps: Submit three predefined responses with different multiple-choice and checkbox answers, then verify that the Responses summary reflects exactly three submissions and the expected answer distribution.
features.expected: Responses summary must show exactly three submissions with the expected answer distribution.

features.name: Stop accepting responses
steps: Publish a form and submit one response, then disable accepting responses and verify that a new responder session can no longer submit another response.
features.expected: After disabling acceptance, new responder sessions cannot submit.

features.name: Import questions
steps: Create a source form containing three questions, create a separate target form, import exactly two specified questions from the source form, and verify that the third question is not imported.
features.expected: Exactly the two specified questions must be imported; the third is not.

features.name: Quiz configuration
steps: Convert a normal form into a quiz, create a four-option multiple-choice question, mark one answer as correct, assign 5 points, and add answer feedback.
features.expected: Quiz conversion must work with a correct answer key and 5-point assignment; feedback applies.

features.name: Quiz end-to-end
steps: Create a three-question quiz worth 10 total points, configure answer keys, publish it, submit a predefined answer set, and verify that the resulting score matches the configured answer keys.
features.expected: Submitted answer set must produce a score matching the configured keys (10 total).

features.name: Full survey workflow
steps: Build Product Evaluation with four sections, six mixed question types, two validated fields, one conditional branch, required-question rules, a custom confirmation message, and a customized theme; publish it, submit one valid response through each branch, and verify both responses in the editor.
features.expected: Full form must publish with all configured elements; one valid response per branch must be verifiable in the editor.
